author: agent:claude-code
message: Rename the project to vg-dotfiles (sibling of vg-dotfiles-windows, matching the folder layout), and record the review fixes: Tailscale SSH via extraSetFlags, the missing Adwaita-dark theme. (proposal 01a146e0-139c-70cf-9a6c-adf35831b253, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

title: Renamed dotfiles to vg-dotfiles; the checkout lives at ~/vg-dotfiles
body: Matches the sibling repo vg-dotfiles-windows and the C:\vg-workspace layout. The GitHub repo, the local folder and this design are renamed together. The checkout path on every Linux/macOS machine is one option, extPaths.dotfilesDir (default ~/vg-dotfiles), that every other extPaths entry and the dot/cdot/zdot/ndot aliases derive from; each machine moves its clone (mv ~/dotfiles ~/vg-dotfiles) before its next rebuild, or its out-of-store config links dangle.

title: Tailscale SSH was set through extraUpFlags, which nixpkgs ignores without an auth key
body: Both the NixOS and the NixOS-WSL tailscale modules put --ssh in services.tailscale.extraUpFlags. nixpkgs passes those only from tailscaled-autoconnect, which exists only when authKeyFile is set, so the ssh option did nothing on vgwsl2, vgsquid-azul and vgsquid-onyx. Found by code review (two reviewers independently); confirmed in nixpkgs' tailscale.nix ("Only applied if services.tailscale.authKeyFile is specified"). Now extraSetFlags, which the tailscaled-set service applies at every boot. Lesson: check where nixpkgs actually consumes an option before relying on it, not just that it evaluates.

title: GTK3 dark theme named Adwaita-dark with nothing installing it
body: autostart.conf set gtk-theme to Adwaita-dark, but gtk3 ships only Default and Emacs theme directories; Adwaita-dark comes from gnome-themes-extra, which vgkraken didn't have, so GTK3 apps (Thunar, pavucontrol) stayed light. Found by code review; confirmed by listing both packages' share/themes. gnome-themes-extra is now in the Hyprland module. Lesson: a theme or icon name in config needs the package that provides it beside it.
